notes.title: Free DLC Update
notes.content: [p]Hello players,[/p][p]Sorry for the lack of updates lately. I’ve been working really hard on improving the Free DLC to make it the best it can be. I’ve made changes to some story beats to enhance the overall experience, and I’m excited to say the DLC will be releasing very soon![/p][p][/p][p]It will include more weapons, greater enemy variety, more humor, and deeper lore and character development within the world of Grandpa. Honestly, I believe this DLC surpasses the base game — even in terms of voice acting, since I was able to hire a couple of talented voice actors thanks to the support and earnings from the game.[/p][p][/p][p]I truly appreciate everyone who’s supported me, my indie studio, and Grandpa. Thank you all![/p][p][/p][h3]Free DLC Trailer 2 - Grandpa High on Retro[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="r_NpPnbgpj8;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: FREE DLC Update
notes.content: [p]Hi Players,[/p][p]Ive run into a few small issues that are causing a slight delay in the release of the Free DLC for Grandpa High on Retro. I want to be honest with you I’m not going to give an exact new date just yet, because I don’t want to promise something I can’t guarantee.[/p][p]That said, the Free DLC is still coming this June, and I'm working hard to make sure everything is ready and running smoothly before release.[/p][p]Thanks so much for your patience and support![/p]

notes.title: FREE DLC Update and HUGE Announcements
notes.content:
[p]Ive been bless with the support you guys are giving to Grandpa. The game officialy has earn enough money to hire personal to bring you this projects:[/p][p]- [b]DLC Delay Announcement[/b]
Our [b]FREE DLC[/b] for [i]Grandpa High on Retro[/i] will be [b]delayed[/b] just a little from [b]June 17 to June 22[/b]. We’re using the extra time to make it even more [i]epic, random, and unforgettable[/i]. Thanks for your patience it will be worth the wait![/p][p][/p][p]-[b]New Spinoff Game Coming This Fall[/b]
That’s right [i]Grandpa High on Retro[/i] is expanding with a brand new [b]spinoff video game[/b], launching [b]this Fall[/b]. Expect more chaos, more laughs, and more lore.[/p][p][/p][p]-[b]Animated Series Incoming[/b][/p][p][b] [/b]Im bringing Grandpa to life in a whole new way an official [b]Grandpa High on Retro animated series[/b] is coming [b]to YouTube this year[/b]! Subscribe and get ready to watch Grandpa going wild.[/p][p][/p][p]-[b]Grandpa High on Retro 2 is in Development[/b][/p][p][b] [/b]You heard it here first. The sequel to the game that started it all is officially in the works.  [b]Grandpa High on Retro 2[/b] is coming—and it's going to be wilder than ever.[/p][p][/p][p]If you want to here more information about this topics I have attached a video that will give more details. Stay tuned for Grandpa High on Retro Free DLC new trailer![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="EhlDcogwwOI;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch 1.2 Announcement – Performance Improvements & Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Im excited to announce that a new patch for Grandpa High on Retro is now live! This update addresses a number of key issues and brings various improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s been fixed and updated:
[b]
What's New in Patch 1.2:[/b]

[b]-Performance Improvements:[/b] We’ve made tweaks to optimize the game’s performance across all platforms, ensuring smoother gameplay and better frame rates.

[b]-Pick-Up Items Glitch Fixed:[/b] The glitch preventing players from picking up items has been resolved – you should no longer experience any issues when collecting your loot!
[b]
-Main Menu[/b] Level Progress Fix: We’ve corrected the issue where some players weren’t seeing accurate level progress in the main menu.

[b]-Level Balancing:[/b] We've improved the balance of enemies, ammunition, and health throughout the levels, ensuring a more enjoyable and challenging experience for everyone.
Minor Bug Fixes: A number of smaller bugs have been resolved to enhance overall stability and performance.
[b]

Important Note:[/b]
If you have the game installed, there may be a chance that it crashes on the first attempt to launch after the update. Don’t worry – simply launch the game again, and it should work perfectly!

[b]What’s Coming Next:[/b]
I’m currently working on a new patch to address other minor bugs. If you encounter any issues or bugs while playing, please let me know in the Community Hub. I’ll add them to the list to ensure they’re fixed in the next patch.

Thank you so much for your continued support, and I hope you enjoy the improvements!

Best,
Ashnell Games

notes.title: Official Release Date Update for Grandpa HIgh on Retro
notes.content:
Dear Future Players,

I apologize for the delay in the release of Grandpa High on Retro, which was originally scheduled for November. I know how eagerly many of you have been anticipating its launch, and we share in your excitement.

However, after careful consideration, Ive decided that the game needed a bit more time to ensure the game meets the high standards that both you and we expect. This decision wasn't made lightly, but it is essential for delivering the best experience possible.

As a result, I will officially pushing back the release to January 29, 2025. I am committed to providing you with a game that is polished, immersive, bugs free and worthy of the incredible support you've shown so far.

I sincerely appreciate your understanding and continued enthusiasm. Thank you for your patience, and I can’t wait to share the final version of Grandpa High on Retro with you in January.

Warm regards,
Ashnell Marchand
